title: Secrets Don't Leave the Room
prompt: He brewed something, then reached for it outside. The world said it had never heard of it.

line_hints.1: Inside the room this line is perfectly legal — secret really does exist there.
line_hints.3: The spell IS cast. It ran, it brewed, and then the room closed.

fixes.why: The only way something leaves a room is if the spell hands it out and someone catches it. Nothing inside survives on its own.
It would print — but the value still never leaves. You have not solved the problem, only stopped asking the question outside.
Two rooms instead of one, both closing behind them. Repetition does not make a local name public.

config.success: What is brewed in the room stays in the room, unless it is handed out and caught.
